title: Comunitario: Carreras en la Pista de Hojasilvestre (Community Event: Kart Races at Hojasilvestre Race Track)
names_seen: Comunitario: Carreras en la Pista de Hojasilvestre (Community Event: Kart Races at Hojasilvestre Race Track)

facts.statement: A community event where Free Realms ambassadors held kart races at the Hojasilvestre race track, located south of the Crossroads teleport stone.
facts.quote: nos reuniremos en el la Pista de Carreras de Hojasilvestre, al sur de la piedra tele-transportadora de Crucecaminos

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice from the official Free Realms site, inviting players to a kart-racing gathering run by the Free Realms ambassador team at the Hojasilvestre race track. It gives two Server 1 session times, one for the Americas and Latin America and one for the UK and Europe, both in March 2011. The page does not give the post date, and the track's English name is not in the client text table.
